general_information.name: OH—RIGHT, MY NAME IS MAYA SANDBERG. THAT’S THE FULL NAME ON MY DOCUMENTS, I THINK.

current_concerns.primary_problems: It’s been... low mood mostly, and I’m sleeping badly, and I just don’t really care about much anymore. Since I moved for work, which was five months ago, it’s all kind of settled in weird. I have hardly any friends here, so I end up skipping meals and just kind of withdrawing from my family on video calls too. I keep thinking I should be doing better than this.
current_concerns.goals: I want to feel like myself again, really. And, um, I’d like to make some friends here too, instead of just counting the days until I go back home.

past_psychiatric_history.previous_diagnoses: I’ve not had one before, no.

personal_history.early_childhood: I was born and raised in Halifax... and I guess I was a pretty happy kid, sort of sociable, always around people. That’s the main thing I remember.
personal_history.adolescence_early_adulthood: I completed an architecture degree, and then I moved to Toronto when I was 21. That’s... basically the big thing, I think.
